settings.description: Select individual soldiers within a squad and show which soldiers are selected. Disabling this also prevents posture, movement, attack, garrison, firing, ammunition, expanded ammo menu and regroup from loading. Pickup and squad-management scrolling can remain enabled. Restart required.
Hold this with TAB on a selected building to select one squad's occupants at a time; plain TAB selects all occupants. ctrl, shift or off. Restart required.

What dragging a box selects. squads: every squad with a soldier or its icon inside, as in the base game; hold Ctrl to select the soldiers inside instead. soldiers: only the soldiers inside. Restart required.
